decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is cheap to maintain and close to the core agency hosting offer, so with slack from industry growth there is no shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The responsive template has low upkeep and fits the core business, but its visibility is weak, so a modest risk remains that it is quietly retired.
Premium support builds directly on the firm's 24/7 expert-support strength and generates recurring revenue, so it likely meets aspirations.
The version management tool has its own page and serves the strategic goal of tools that cut recurring work for agencies, so the firm will carry it.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but it meets GDPR-driven demand from 2018 and costs little to run, so slack allows keeping it despite uncertain results.
